columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: The registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token.
columns.method: The firm scope of the custody entry the silver partition is read under, taken from the registry.

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: The account key carried by the silver row. It is an identifier and is not reproduced in any report.

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: The silver partition's business date, the date= partition the row is written under.

columns.name: trade_date
columns.meaning: The trade_date column of the transaction table, read as the closing trade's trade date (round-128 ground read); null when the row carries none.

columns.name: settle_date
columns.meaning: The settlement date: the settlmnt_date column of the transaction table (round-128 ground read). The round-123 absent claim is void; the live schema carries the column. Null when the value is missing or unparsable.

columns.name: action
columns.meaning: The action word of the row: the txn_type's action through type_action. Null only when the code is not in the mapping.
columns.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping to the ratified type word, then type_action (the type word to its action word); a code the mapping holds as UNMAPPED or lacks gives a null action.

columns.name: txn_type
columns.meaning: The ratified type word of the row, or the string UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.
columns.method: tran_srcde through source_mapping (the 49 Financial code to its ratified type word); UNMAPPED when the mapping holds the code as UNMAPPED or lacks it.

columns.name: symbol
columns.meaning: The security symbol, the ticker_symbol column; null on a row with no security.

columns.name: asset_name
columns.meaning: The security's name. The live schema (140 columns) has no name column (round-128 ground read), so the column is null on every row.

columns.name: units
columns.meaning: The quantity column, named as the units (round-128 ground read); null when the row carries none.

columns.name: price
columns.meaning: The price column (round-128 ground read); null when the row carries none.

columns.name: amount
columns.meaning: The custodian's gross money amount (gross_amount). On a cash row the sign is taken from debit_credit as account_return_daily takes it: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative. On an in-kind row debit_credit is a position side and is not read as a cash sign.
columns.method: gross_amount, the money column the adapter declares (money_column). The sign is taken from debit_credit on cash rows: CREDIT positive, DEBIT negative (direction_map).

columns.name: fee
columns.meaning: The stated sum, for 49 Financial, of the columns the contract's fee_basis names (commission, exchange_processing_fee, broker_service_fee, prime_broker_fee, trade_away_fee, redemption_fee, other_fee, step_in_fee, research_fee). A null column counts as nothing; a row whose named columns are all null has fee null, never zero.
columns.method: Per row, the sum of the fee-named columns listed in from_columns and of commission; null when every listed column is null. markupmarkdown is not summed (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm is not summed (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).

columns.name: custodian
columns.meaning: The custodian of the row: the custody entry's constant (sources.json custodian). The round-128 ground read names custdian_id as the custodian identity column; the constant is what a person reads, and custdian_id is not read onto the row.
columns.method: The custodian identity column of the row (custdian_id). Its values are not read by the census; the claim is inferred from the column name.

columns.name: flow_class
columns.meaning: The flow class of the row's tran_srcde code: EXTERNAL_IN, EXTERNAL_OUT, INCOME, FEE, INTERNAL, CORPORATE_ACTION or UNRESOLVED.
columns.method: Per tran_srcde through flow_class_rule over the CRO table's (partition, rule) pairs: one class when the code's CRO rows agree, UNRESOLVED when they disagree or the table does not hold the code. The silver-only codes and IRAWH and MCE are fixed in source_mapping. The round-128 ground read names the key (tran_srcde, tr_cd, sb_cd); this contract keys on tran_srcde, the key source_mapping holds.

columns.name: source_txn_id
columns.meaning: The per-transaction identifier: the cashiering_transaction_identifier column (round-128 ground read), read by name; null when the row carries none.
columns.method: The per-transaction cashiering identifier column, read by name; values not read.

49financial.rule: The fee is the stated sum of the nine listed columns. For each line it is the sum of the non-null values of commission, exchange_processing_fee, broker_service_fee, prime_broker_fee, trade_away_fee, redemption_fee, other_fee, step_in_fee and research_fee. A null column counts as nothing. A line whose nine columns are all null has fee null, never zero. Excluded by the round-128 ground read: markupmarkdown (a price markup, not a fee charge) and exec_brok_comm (its meaning as a fee is not established from the census or the tracked records).

cottonwood.rule: The fee is the stated sum of Transaction Fee and Account Fee per line. A null column counts as nothing. A line whose two columns are both null has fee null, never zero. No producer exists yet (firms_pending).

flow_class_rule.reason: An account transfer is internal only when its counterparty leg is matched, and the line does not carry the counterparty.
A journal is internal or external by its counterparty, which the line does not carry.
A share delivery is internal when its other leg sits in a sister account, and the line does not state which.
A classified check's direction is not stated by the rule, so it cannot be classed until a specimen is read.
A returned deposit reverses a deposit whose direction the rule does not state, so the table does not settle its class.
The partition is money entering the account from outside the firm.
The partition is money leaving the account to outside it, and an IRA withholding is paid out of the account.
A check paid out of the account leaves the account to a payee outside it.
A withdrawal moves cash or securities from the account to outside the firm.
An administrative fee charged to the account is a fee whatever its label.
A service fee charged to the account is a fee.
An explicit advisor fee debited from the account is a management fee, which is a fee.
An advisory fee debited from the account is a fee.
A verified advisor fee is a fee against the fee record.
Alternative income is income earned inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition, which the return engine treats as inside the account.
A cash-in-lieu payment for a fractional share is a corporate action inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on a holding is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A corporate action on an in-kind position is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A miscellaneous corporate action is an event inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A dividend is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A foreign tax withheld on income is taken inside the account, so it stays an INTERNAL movement.
An interest adjustment is income inside the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
Interest is income earned by the account, read from the INTERNAL partition.
A reinvestment moves income back into the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A sweep moves cash between the account's own holdings, an INTERNAL movement.
A trade moves value between cash and a position inside the account, an INTERNAL movement.
A withholding taken inside the account is an INTERNAL movement.
The table holds no rule for the line, so its class is the table's own unresolved state.
A lending or miscellaneous in-kind line cannot be classed until a specimen shows its direction.
A miscellaneous adjustment's cash direction is not stated by the table, so it stays UNRESOLVED until a specimen is read.

postulates.mece: Declared domain: the 160 live 49 Financial codes of the round-124 census, each in exactly one state. MEASURED is a code the mapping holds as a type word, UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE a code it holds as UNMAPPED, and CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING a code the mapping lacks. Subtracting the mapped and the UNMAPPED codes from the 160 leaves none, so CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING is 0 in the live read and the per_value counts sum to the denominator.
postulates.same_grain: Grain: one value per transaction line, read from the line's tran_srcde code through source_mapping and computed at row build. It is the grain of txn_type and flow_class; it is never an account, a day or a firm total. A code the mapping lacks is a line-level value, and the line is counted, never dropped.
postulates.intent_coherence: One intent: say whether the line's code has a ratified reading, so a reader knows whether the txn_type and action on the row are the ratified word or the Unclassified display. Each of the three values answers that one question. The money direction of a line is a different intent and belongs to flow_class, so coverage never carries it.
postulates.state_coherence: Which values one remedy does NOT move: ratifying an UNMAPPED code as a word moves only that code's rows from UNMAPPED_BY_TABLE to MEASURED; a new code in a later read moves only its own rows to CODE_NOT_IN_MAPPING until the mapping holds it. Neither remedy moves flow_class, which the CRO table gives per code, nor any other code's coverage.

postulates.mece: Declared domain: the 30 (partition, rule) pairs of the CRO classification table (187 rows, 157 distinct codes). Every pair the table holds is one of the 30 and the checker finds none outside them, so the subtraction leaves no uncovered pair. Each pair takes one of the seven classes, and a code whose rows disagree takes UNRESOLVED, so every code has exactly one class.
postulates.same_grain: Grain: one class per tran_srcde code, derived from that code's (partition, rule) rows in the CRO table and carried by each line of the code. The rule reads table rows, not account, day or amount values, so a line of the same code always carries the same class.
postulates.intent_coherence: One intent: does money cross the account boundary. EXTERNAL_IN and EXTERNAL_OUT say yes, by direction. INTERNAL, INCOME and CORPORATE_ACTION say the money stays inside the account. FEE says a charge is taken from the account. UNRESOLVED says the table does not settle the question. Every pair is classed by that one question and by nothing else.
postulates.state_coherence: Which values one remedy does NOT move: a specimen that settles one UNRESOLVED pair moves only that pair and the codes whose only row it is; it moves no EXTERNAL_IN or EXTERNAL_OUT pair. The silver-only codes and the two fixed codes are set in source_mapping and move no pair of the table, so the 30-pair rule is unchanged by them.
